info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Ecommerce Cart Taxs-v5-spec
info.description: The Ecommerce Cart Tax Retrieval API allows users to access tax information associated with shopping carts in their ecommerce platform. This API facilitates the retrieval of applicable tax rates based on cart contents and customer location to ensure accurate pricing. Typically utilized by online retailers and developers integrating ecommerce functionalities, this endpoint simplifies tax calculations during the shopping experience. Users can make GET requests to obtain up-to-date tax details for various cart scenarios.

get.summary: Retrieve tax information for the cart.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to obtain the applicable tax details for the items currently in the cart, helping you understand the total cost involved in a purchase.

requestBody.description: Request to retrieve the tax information applied to the items in the cart. This body allows for customization of the tax query based on the specific items and their locations.

200.description: Successfully retrieved tax information for the cart.
